Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
DOC-0032 2026-08-23
MEMORANDUM
Date: 2026-08-23
To: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA queue coordinators
From: PERSON-0010, TEAM-0004
Subject: Priority Change Freeze During the BETA Records Audit
Decision: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA will freeze changes to existing priority
fields during the records audit week, 2026-08-24 through 2026-08-28. This is
an administrative comparison period so the audit clerks can trace decisions
against a stable set of dated papers.
New issues still receive an initial priority and written reason at intake. The
freeze concerns changes to an existing rank; it leaves the intake requirement
and the ownership and follow-up duties intact.
Keep proposed changes in a dated hold register. Apply reason-before-rank:
record the scheduling concern and consequence of delay before the proposed
label. Add the submitting role and the review appointment after the audit
week. Do not copy a proposal into the source record during the freeze.
The audit chair will review held proposals from 2026-08-31, preserving their
original submission dates. A proposal that needs clarification returns to its
submitting coordinator with a question and a response date. Its age does not
establish its merits.
The cabin example is located through DEMO-AIR-0002, ISSUE-O111, and
TASK-0997. It shows where a reference belongs in the hold register without
proposing a change for that record.
Implementation: PERSON-0010 will brief station clerks on the distinction
between initial intake and later changes before the freeze begins. Retain the
briefing note with the audit calendar.
D. Worker 0010
Demo Worker 0010, Demo Team 04
